scope: Implementation traceability, not complete normative/architectural proof

groups.contract: RV64 signed/unsigned/W multiply and divide; arithmetic corner cases; in-order architectural retirement.
groups.status: integrated; directed coverage; complete architectural validation remains open

groups.contract: W/D LR/SC and AMO; contiguous aligned 64-byte reservation; commit authority, SRAM acquire/release ordering, external snoops, eventual constrained-loop progress. Broader concurrent-agent memory-ordering proof remains open.
groups.status: integrated; directed coverage; complete architectural validation remains open

groups.contract: H-min/S/D boxing, conversion, rounding and exception flags; FS/SD in real and guest contexts; FP memory faults.
groups.status: integrated; directed coverage; complete architectural validation remains open

groups.contract: B expands to Zba/Zbb/Zbs; conditional-zero instructions use fixed issue/result timing.
groups.status: integrated; directed coverage; complete architectural validation remains open

groups.contract: Compressed forms for RV64 including D and Zcb, all may-be-operation encodings, original instruction bits retained for precise illegal traps.
groups.status: integrated; directed coverage; complete architectural validation remains open

groups.contract: CSR evaluation is separate from commit; cycle/time/instret and four HPM counters; M/S/H counter controls and privilege filters.
groups.status: integrated; directed coverage; complete architectural validation remains open

groups.contract: Main-memory instruction fetch is coherent with authoritative accepted stores. Naturally aligned <=32-bit fetch lies within a single 64-bit bank word. Broader race validation remains open.
groups.status: integrated; directed coverage; complete architectural validation remains open

groups.contract: Ordinary integer/FP misalignment in main memory; split translation/PMP/attributes validated before stores; IO is not split.
groups.status: integrated; directed coverage; complete architectural validation remains open

groups.contract: Hints decode as legal inert operations and have no architectural register or memory side effects.
groups.status: integrated; directed coverage; complete architectural validation remains open

groups.contract: 64-byte cache blocks; zero performs authoritative bus stores, clean drains write-through state, invalidate/flush update real cache tags; CSR permissions and precise faults.
groups.status: integrated; directed coverage; complete architectural validation remains open

groups.contract: Data-independent execution latency for the mandated scalar set. Finite identical-text/different-data retirement profiles passed; this is not an exhaustive timing proof.
groups.status: integrated; directed coverage; complete architectural validation remains open

groups.contract: VLEN128/ELEN64; full vector state/FP/integer/memory ownership and restart. Timing probes cover 231 forms, with an injected data-dependent early-exit control rejected. Full architectural and timing validation remains open.
groups.status: integrated; directed coverage; complete architectural validation remains open

groups.contract: STO bounded timeout, NTO reservation/interrupt/debug wake, bounded TW/VTW interception. Unlike WFI, U NTO with TW=0 is permitted.
groups.status: integrated; directed coverage; complete architectural validation remains open

groups.contract: PMLEN0/7 WARL and effective-privilege context, transformed fault VA, unmasked fetch/HLVX; HUPMM and MPRV+MPV paths integrated.
groups.status: integrated; directed coverage; complete architectural validation remains open

groups.contract: FENCE.I drains older memory and invalidates I-cache/frontend state. All fences conservatively drain all data classes, which also satisfies FIOM expansions.
groups.status: integrated; directed coverage; complete architectural validation remains open

groups.contract: S state/returns/permissions; Bare and Sv39; software A/D faults; PTE reads pass PMP and the coherent main-memory path. Mandatory machine mconfigptr is implemented as read-only zero. Full Ss1p13 clause audit remains open.
groups.status: integrated; directed coverage; complete architectural validation remains open

groups.contract: All 4-byte-aligned direct stvec bases; precise VA/instruction trap values; implemented counter enable bits writable; UXL fixed64.
groups.status: integrated; directed coverage; complete architectural validation remains open

groups.contract: PBMT with M/H enable layers and final VS-stage override, conservative global invalidation, 64-KiB NAPOT leaves; ordering-only Svinval fences ignore TVM/VTVM and trap VU with cause22.
groups.status: integrated; directed coverage; complete architectural validation remains open

groups.contract: S and VS timer compare, enable/counter gating, htimedelta addition and virtual timer interrupt delivery; CLINT natural64 timer accesses.
groups.status: integrated; directed coverage; complete architectural validation remains open

groups.contract: HPM OF and MINH/SINH/UINH/VSINH/VUINH, scountovf filtering, a single LCOFIP pending owner and overflow interrupt delivery.
groups.status: integrated; directed coverage; complete architectural validation remains open

groups.contract: M/HS/VS/VU state, aliases, delegation, interrupts, HLV/HSV/HLVX, two-stage translation including implicit VS PTE G faults, guest vector restart, all satp modes mirrored in vsatp/hgatp; Hstateen and counter controls. Full H architectural coverage remains open.
groups.status: integrated; directed coverage; complete architectural validation remains open
